title: ADF land comment reply
description: The fields of one tracker issue's hand-off comment after the change's merge: what was done, how a tester checks it, and for a partial issue what remains. Plain text only; the tracker plugin renders its own comment from the fields and adds the merge request link itself. land.mjs comment also refuses what the schema cannot see: a key or state other than the dispatch's, a missing or empty field, remains on a taken issue, a field over its word limit (done 80, test 120, remains 80), and a link or URL in any field.
